name: MKI Merge Versions
overview: Two resolutions, one entry. You choose which version leads.
description: Merges movies that exist in several resolutions into a single library entry, matched by TMDb ID (IMDb as fallback), never by title. The highest resolution or the version closest to 1080p becomes the primary version, as you choose. Runs as a scheduled task and automatically once the library has been quiet for five minutes. Includes a dry-run mode.
changelog: New setting: choose the primary version of a merged movie, either 1080p or the highest resolution. The highest resolution stays the default. With "Apply to existing merges" on, the next run switches existing merges to your choice, so a switch to 1080p makes merged movies open and play in their 1080p version. A movie without a 1080p file uses the version closest to it (720p before 4K, 4K before a DVD copy). Favourites, ratings and likes now move with the primary version, so nothing seems lost after a switch. Changing the choice while live asks first.
